memory.verdict: Still pricing up into year-end: TrendForce (2026-09-30) sees 4Q26 conventional DRAM contract prices +10-15% and NAND +15-20% q/q, with enterprise SSD the only category accelerating; but consumer demand is weakening (smartphone builds shrinking, PC brands cutting SSD capacity). Samsung's Q3 preliminary (~2026-10-07/08) guided record operating profit of about KRW 107.4T on KRW 195T sales and says supply stays tight into 2028; Micron (2026-09-30) guided FQ1 revenue $61.5B but gross margin slightly lower at 86.25% (from 87.0%) and raised FY27 capex. Supply response is building: Samsung P5 Ph1 DRAM/HBM equipment move-in reportedly pulled forward to May-June 2027 (output from 2028); hyperscaler capex updates come 2026-10-28/29.

storage_hdd.verdict: Still supply-tight. Both majors guided the September quarter to ~$4.1B revenue (WDC GM 55-56%; Seagate EPS $7.30), lead times are reported at up to two years, and capacity is committed into 2028. A possible first crack in supply discipline: on 2026-10-02 Nikkei reported (not yet confirmed by Toshiba) Toshiba (~11% share) will roughly double AI data-centre HDD capacity by its FY2027 with a ~¥60B (~$380M) Philippines expansion (STX -12%, WDC -10% that day; tikr.com, blocksandfiles.com). WDC's June-quarter exabyte growth also slowed to 22% y/y from ~30%. The WDC (10-22) and STX (~10-28) reports are the next checks.

mrna_vaccines.verdict: Moderna is now valued on its cancer vaccine, not on its respiratory vaccines. Q2 2026 revenue was only $145M, with a $782M loss and $6.9B in cash. The Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial met its primary endpoint in August, and mFLUSIVA was approved on 2026-08-05. Full Phase 3 data on 2026-10-24 is the next binary event. Citi cut the stock to sell on 2026-09-30, saying it would take about $26B a year in cancer sales to justify a price near $200. The norovirus Phase 3 interim analysis has already missed its early-success criteria (Q2 release).

ai_servers.verdict: Demand is still accelerating. In fiscal Q2 2027 (reported 2026-09-01), Dell booked a record $60.9B of AI orders against $16.4B of AI server revenue, lifting its backlog to $95B, and raised FY27 AI server guidance to $74B and revenue guidance to $192B. Nvidia guided its next quarter to $108B. The risks are execution and margins: rising DRAM, NAND and CPU costs and shortages, and large customers looking at buying from ODMs. The next read on cloud capex is Microsoft on 2026-10-28.

oil_refining.verdict: Refining is in a war-driven supercycle. The USGC 3-2-1 crack averaged $71/bbl in September 2026 (diesel $104, versus $26 in September 2025), and the diesel crack hit a record $102.20 on 2026-08-17 and an intraday $108 in early September, because Persian Gulf outages and strikes on Russian refineries left global refinery throughput about 5M bpd lower year on year. US distillate stocks were 105.1M bbl in the week to 2026-10-02 (12-13% below the 5-year average), gasoline 5% below, and utilization 92.7% after a 96.8% peak in September. RBN says cracks turned down in early October but were still more than 2.5 times October 2025. Iran talks (Trump ruled out a strike before the 2026-11-03 midterms) are now the main risk to margins. Structural support: Valero's Benicia closure (145k bpd, idled by April 2026) and lower US operable capacity (18.03M bpd); offsets: Dangote now at 700k bpd and exporting. EPA's final 2026-27 RFS (26.81B RINs, 70% SRE reallocation) keeps D4 RINs strong.

freight_intermodal.verdict: Demand is turning up and capacity is tight, but costs arrive before price increases. On 2026-09-16 J.B. Hunt guided Q3 EPS 5-10% below Q2's $1.91 because of driver costs (about $25M) and fuel (at least $10M). Truck freight is about 32% dearer than intermodal (Sonar), and contract repricing starts with the October-Q4 bid season (about 10% of contracts). The UP-NS merger is under STB review, targeting mid-2027.

us_steel.verdict: Earnings are near a cycle high but slightly below hopes. On 2026-09-17 Nucor guided Q3 EPS to $5.55-5.65 (versus $6.17 consensus and $2.63 a year earlier) and Steel Dynamics to $5.34-5.38 (versus $5.66 consensus and $2.74 a year earlier). Both cited higher selling prices; Steel Dynamics cited record shipments and lower scrap costs, while raw-material and recycling earnings fall. Results come Oct 19 (STLD) and Oct 26 (NUE).

custody_banks.verdict: Late-upcycle but still accelerating into Q3 prints: in July both raised FY26 guidance on deposits and market levels - STT to NII +14-15% (from +8-10%), fees +12-13%, expenses ~+8%; Q2 AUC/A $57.9T (+18% YoY), deposits $319.5B (+13%) (https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/state-street-q2-earnings-call-highlights, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000093751/000009375126000387/exhibit992-2q26earningsrel.htm); BNY to NII +12-13% (from +10%) with expenses raised to +6-7% (https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/bny-q3-2026-earnings-revenue-preview-guidance-key-metrics). The risk has shifted from NII to expense creep and to deposit/market-level reversal; STT reports 2026-10-14, BNY 2026-10-15 (BNY Q3 consensus ~$5.55B revenue, GAAP EPS ~$2.27).

ai_power_infrastructure.verdict: Order and backlog phase still expanding, with no sign yet of a peak: at Q2 (reported 2026-07-22) GEV gas-turbine backlog plus slot reservations hit 116 GW (from 100 GW in Q1; target >=125 GW by YE26), Power orders $16.7B (+134% organic), data-centre orders >$5B YTD (https://www.turbomachinerymag.com/view/ge-vernova-gas-turbine-backlog-hits-116-gw-as-power-orders-more-than-double); PWR record backlog $53B with FY26 revenue guide raised to $39.3-39.7B (https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/quanta-services-q2-earnings-call-highlights); VRT Q2 sales +24% and FY26 guide raised to $13.8-14.2B, 30-32% organic (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001674101/000162828026050323/q22026exhibit991vrt07292026.htm). The whole cluster depends on hyperscaler capex (Moody's: ~$785B in 2026, approaching $1T in 2027, https://datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/moodys-hyperscaler-capex-forecasts-marked-up-by-85bn-to-close-in-on-1trn-by-2027/); late-October hyperscaler and Q3 company prints are the next test.
